draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.70, the 7th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 1st of 36 at CB. He went 17th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Dominique Rodgers-Cromartie. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (83rd percentile), vertical jump (94th percentile), broad jump (91st percentile). College production: 7 passes defended in 2022, 15th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the New England Patriots. 34 career games and 34 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 8 AV in 2025 against a career-best 10 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: approximate value 8 (94th percentile), missed tackle rate 4.2% (90th percentile), completion % allowed 53.6% (85th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 cornerback who played: 75.7% season snap share against a median of 40.4%, above the norm.
